crossRefs.note: Yahweh says, “Behold, a people comes from the north country. A great nation will be stirred up from the uttermost parts…
They take hold of bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride on…
Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.
Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.
Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.
Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not…
who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one…
I was angry with my people. I profaned my inheritance and gave them into your hand. You showed them no mercy. You laid…
For, behold, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, that march through the width of the earth, to…
For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.
For they poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.”
Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling.
The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

At the noise of the stamping of the hoofs of his strong ones, at the rushing of his chariots, at the rumbling of his…

Their horses also are swifter than leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves. Their horsemen press proudly…
The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

translations.web: They take up bow and spear. They are cruel, and have no mercy. Their voice roars like the sea. They ride on horses, everyone set in array, as a man to the battle, against you, daughter of Babylon.
translations.bsb: They grasp the bow and spear; they are cruel and merciless. Their voice roars like the sea, and they ride upon horses, lined up like men in formation against you, O Daughter of Babylon.
translations.kjv: They shall hold the bow and the lance: they are cruel, and will not shew mercy: their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
translations.asv: They lay hold on bow and spear; they are cruel, and have no mercy; their voice roareth like the sea; and they ride upon horses, every one set in array, as a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.
